result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d make **curiosity and critical thinking** the default human instincts.

Imagine a world where people instinctively ask “why?” before accepting an answer, seek evidence before forming beliefs, and approach disagreement with genuine openness rather than defensiveness. So much of the world’s suffering comes from fear, misinformation, and tribalism—all of which thrive when people stop questioning. Curiosity would make us better learners, better neighbors, and better stewards of the planet.

I’d choose that because it’s not a single fix; it’s a seed that grows into countless others.
